correctness.rationale: The exact rate has one strictly convex and one strictly concave interval; the contact residual has derivative (t-L)r''(t), one zero between inflection and peak. Strict chord slope and strict concavity construct the exact least concave majorant. Jensen and strict equality conditions cover all Borel laws, endpoint and transition cases. The unique gain maximum and cubic coefficient follow from a nonzero third derivative. Standard-library CHECK.py passed 85,188 fixed-seed numerical diagnostics, supplemental to the proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-mean, bounded-temperature design question is intrinsic to rate-summation predictions of insect development. The exact optimizer distinguishes cold-extreme mixing, plateau at a uniquely determined warm temperature, and deterministic warm operation, gives sharp uniqueness and transition, and predicts a nontrivial cubic maximal-gain onset independent of additive rate intercept. No claim is made about biological fitness, field intervention or unconstrained control costs.
